dictionary.channel_boost_warning: Above 100% the signal is amplified: it may distort.
dictionary.channel_unavailable: Audio system unavailable on the server: {error}
dictionary.title: Microphone
dictionary.description: Listening, wake word and audio cleanup of {assistant} on this node
dictionary.notice_unpaired: This node is only discovered on the mesh: pair it from Nodes & Servers to manage its microphone.
dictionary.notice_paired: The node applies listening settings on next contact. The microphone is chosen on the device.
dictionary.wake_hint: Change it by choosing a new name for the assistant.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_hint: Keeps listening for the wake word.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_MODE_hint: Offline keeps everything on the server; online uses the cloud for more accuracy.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_MULTILANG_hint: When off it only listens to the main language.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_VOICEPRINT_ENFORCE_hint: Ignores TV and strangers: answers only household voices.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_AUTO_FOLLOWUP_hint: Seconds in which you can continue without repeating the name.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_MAX_GAIN_hint: How much the signal can be raised for distant speakers.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_TARGET_RMS_hint: Level the auto-leveller brings the voice to.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_EQ_hint: Only for difficult microphones: applied to phrases before automatic cleanup.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_EQ_HIGHPASS_hint: Removes rumble, hum and low background noise (0 = off).
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_EQ_LOW_hint: Below about 250 Hz: lower it if the voice sounds boomy.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_EQ_MID_hint: Around 1 kHz: the range that makes speech intelligible.
dictionary.setting_NUXIVA_EAR_EQ_HIGH_hint: Above about 4 kHz: raise it if the voice sounds muffled or distant.
dictionary.test_intro: Watch the level while you speak, then record 5 seconds and hear exactly what reaches the server.
dictionary.test_error_mic_busy: The microphone is already in use by another test: try again in a moment.
dictionary.test_error_mic_unavailable: No microphone available on the server: check the selected device.
dictionary.test_error_mic_stalled: The microphone stopped sending audio during the test.
dictionary.test_error_mic_closed: Recording stopped: the microphone was closed.
dictionary.test_error_meter_closed: The live level could not be opened.
dictionary.test_error_mictest_denied: Administrator access is required to test the microphone.
dictionary.test_verdict_ok: Good level: the voice comes through clearly without clipping.
dictionary.test_verdict_raise: The voice is too quiet: move the microphone closer or raise the input volume.
dictionary.test_verdict_lower: The voice is clipping: lower the input volume or move the microphone away.
dictionary.test_verdict_silent: No voice detected: speak during the recording or check the microphone.
dictionary.test_processed_hint: The second track includes the automatic phrase gain; noise cleanup is not included.
dictionary.test_processed_hint_eq: The second track includes equalization and the automatic phrase gain; noise cleanup is not included.
dictionary.test_autotuned: Gain limits were adjusted automatically by the reviews; reset them from the Voice listening panel.
